exclusion_reason: Cold start (WebAssembly module compile plus instantiate) and warm re-instantiate are measured for the recompiled module, but this is time-to-first-executable-instruction, not time-to-first-frame, and no graphics or streamed-asset runtime exists to include, so the frame-inclusive budget on the reference host is not certified.
promotion_trigger: Promote to passing when cold and warm start, including WebAssembly compile and asset streaming to the first frame, hold their declared budget on the pinned reference host.
expected_failing_assertion: The measurement covers only compile and instantiate to the first executable instruction; no streamed-asset or graphics runtime contributes, so the frame-inclusive budget cannot be measured.
active_gate_evidence: test/performance.test.mjs (benchmarkColdStart) measures cold start as the full recompile plus WebAssembly module compile and instantiate, and warm start as re-instantiate of the compiled module, asserts warm is not slower than cold, that asset streaming is not included, and that the frame-inclusive budget stays red (measured_on_reference_desktop false, is_bar_cleared false) with the declared budget pinned.
procedure: Measure cold start including compile and streaming.
Measure warm start on the same host.
Compare both against the declared budget.
pass_criterion: Cold and warm start hold their budget.
